ideas.pitch: Real-time collaborative workspace for competitive programmers featuring synchronized multi-cursor code editors and live visual AST execution traces.
ideas.title: AlgoSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core team-based competitive programming format of AlgoSSTrike by directly solving team communication bottlenecks during high-pressure 3-hour qualifiers.

ideas.pitch: Automated test-case generator and stress-testing harness designed to find corner cases and TLE vulnerabilities for algorithmic solutions before submission.
ideas.title: CP-Tactician
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the high penalty of wrong answers and Time Limit Exceeded errors in competitive programming contests where speed and correctness are paramount.

ideas.pitch: A custom contest platform extension that tracks team velocity, problem difficulty hot-spots, and dynamic time-allocation strategies during mock rounds.
ideas.title: AlgoDrill
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the rigorous team dynamics of AlgoSSTrike, giving teams a strategic edge by analyzing historical split-second decision patterns.

ideas.pitch: A specialized low-overhead visual memory and stack inspector tailored for C and C++ competitive programmers to quickly spot segmentation faults and out-of-bounds errors.
ideas.title: BitWise-Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on C and C++ which are primary languages for high-speed competitive programming, solving the pain point of obscure runtime errors.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast offline snippet manager and algorithm template repository with instant fuzzy search and complexity lookup for restricted internet environments.
ideas.title: CP-Playbook
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly respects the strict rule of limited internet access during the contest by providing an ultra-responsive, self-contained reference tool.
